RE_Kenshi.what: C++ plugin loader — patches Kenshi executable, enables code-level mods
RE_Kenshi.kenshiReborn: NOT NEEDED — esotericWebb IS the engine. Mods ARE native Rust plugins. No need to reverse-engineer and patch — the engine is open source (AGPL-3.0).
RE_Kenshi.key_insight: RE_Kenshi exists because Kenshi's engine is closed. OUR engine is open. Every feature RE_Kenshi hacks in, we provide natively.

Dust_Rendering.what: Full rendering framework — GI, SSAO, shadows, DoF, bloom, DLSS/FSR, color grading
Dust_Rendering.kenshiReborn: NATIVE — barraCuda compute shaders provide all of this. Vulkan pipeline = modern by default. No need to inject into an ancient Ogre3D renderer.
Dust_Rendering.key_insight: Dust hooks into Ogre's DX11 pipeline to add modern rendering. We START with Vulkan. The rendering IS modern.

KenshiLua.what: Lua scripting extension — players want to script game logic
KenshiLua.kenshiReborn: NATIVE — squirrel MCP provides full scripting via LLM agents + Rust plugin API. Even BETTER than Lua — NPC behavior driven by AI, not scripts.
KenshiLua.key_insight: KenshiLua's explosive growth proves the community is DESPERATE for scripting. We give them something even better — AI-driven behavior.

Genesis.what: Total world overhaul — 'Kenshi 1.5'. New factions, cities rebuilt, 250+ armor, 40+ weapons, 5000+ dialogue, city siege system
Genesis.kenshiReborn: ABSORB — Genesis IS the community's vision of what Kenshi should be. We make this NATIVE. City sieges, dynamic faction size, expanded content — all built into the engine.
Genesis.key_insight: Genesis proves the community wants MORE content, MORE depth, MORE dynamic world. They spent years building it by hand. We give them tools to build 100x more.

Reactive_World.what: Dynamic world states — faction consequences, supply line effects, territory shifts
Reactive_World.kenshiReborn: NATIVE — sweetGrass knowledge graph + bingoCube coordination = reactive world by default. Every action has consequences tracked in the DAG.

Kaizo.what: Vanilla+ overhaul for repeat playthroughs. Lore-friendly additions.
Kaizo.kenshiReborn: ABSORB — Kaizo's philosophy (more content, same feel) aligns perfectly

the_strategy.phase_1_absorb: Mine ALL top mods. Parse their .mod files. Extract every item, character, faction, building, dialogue addition. Feed to Gaia's blend.
the_strategy.phase_2_rebuild: Implement every mod's feature NATIVELY in esotericWebb. What takes 17 separate mods in Kenshi = 1 engine config in KenshiReborn.
the_strategy.phase_3_exceed: Build what mods CAN'T do: dynamic economy, boats, multiplayer, LLM AI, GPU physics, procedural content.
the_strategy.phase_4_community: Open the engine (AGPL-3.0). Modders who spent years hacking Kenshi can now build NATIVELY. RE_Kenshi's entire purpose becomes obsolete because the engine is OPEN.
the_strategy.phase_5_pitch: Show Lo-Fi Games: 'Your community built Kenshi 1.5 with duct tape and reverse engineering. We built Kenshi 2.0 with sovereign Rust. Your modders can build 100x more with our engine than they ever could with Ogre3D + FCS.'

key_insight: The Kenshi modding community has spent YEARS building what should have been in the engine. RE_Kenshi reverse-engineers the executable. Dust hacks the renderer. Genesis rebuilds every city by hand. KenshiLua adds scripting from scratch. ALL of this work proves what the community WANTS. We build it native. We make their years of work into engine features. Every mod becomes unnecessary because the engine does it all.
